scope: Public metric families defined in xllm/core/common/metrics.cpp; static C/C++ symbol and macro scan under xllm/
notes: Static reference index, not a runtime accuracy or reachability verdict.
Sites are one-based and relative to the repository root at the recorded commits.
Write-macro searches retain updates inside metrics.cpp; explicit symbols expose indirect cached-handle writes.
Descriptions are source intent, not verified contracts; time units, observation objects and coverage require boundary analysis.
The pinned exporter emits custom numeric metrics as gauge; only rpc_server-prefixed recorders are assembled into summaries.
MultiDimension dimensions are flattened into metric names in this pinned fork, not Prometheus labels.
Recorder names include configured percentile suffixes; latency_scale_factor applies to every recorder observation.
One family may create many exported subvariables or dimensions; family_count is not exported-series count.
